messages:
ingrid (auditor): Hi team — can you provide evidence for onboarding the new inference-routing service? Need: RBAC change record, MFA enforcement for service owners, KMS key usage logs for the service account, and a short vuln-triage summary for the last 30 days. auditor deadline Tue EOD.
meera (sec-eng): Yup. Quick checklist: 1) PR/approval for the RBAC role 2) IdP policy & MFA config 3) KMS access logs (sigv4/CloudTrail or Splunk slice) 4) vuln tickets + mitigations. Which envs do you need? prod only or prod+staging?
sam (infra): prod + staging please. I can export key usage from 2024-11-01..2024-11-30. Will be KMS CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-routing.
liz (devops): RBAC change was PR #4821 (service-role: inference-runner). Approved by @meera and merged on 2024-11-05. I can paste the merge commit if needed.
meera (sec-eng): MFA: Onboarding owners are in the IdP group 'sec-service-owners' — MFA required via Conditional Access policy 'CA-Require-MFA-Privops' since 2024-09-01. I can attach the policy screenshot.
jordan (oncall): For logs, here's the Splunk query I used to pull KMS decrypt events for that ARN: 
```
index=prod_kms "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-routing" action=Decrypt OR action=GenerateDataKey
| stats count by src_ip, user, eventName, _time
| sort -_time
```
jordan (oncall): I can run and send CSV with first/last 100 events and a 1-minute ringbuffer around any suspicious time ranges ingrid points out.
ingrid (auditor): Good — also need proof that service account privileges were scoped (no admin perms) and that emergency access path is documented. Small ask: give me an example log that shows a normal decrypt vs a rotate event.
sam (infra): Normal decrypt event sample (CloudTrail JSON compressed):
```
{ "eventTime": "2024-11-12T14:03:22Z", "eventName": "Decrypt", "userIdentity": {"arn":"arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/service-account/inference-runner"}, "requestParameters": {"keyId":"alias/rw-infer-routing"} }
```
sam (infra): KMS rotate_key (manual rotation) emits CreateKey/RotateKey events; we have rotation telemetry logged to audit-bucket. Will attach manifest.
liz (devops): Privilege proof: inference-runner role has only kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, s3:GetObject on model-artifacts/*, and ecs:RunTask. No iam:*, no kms:CreateKey. See IAM diff in PR #4821.
meera (sec-eng): Vulnerability triage: last 30 days — 1 medium finding (container base image outdated) assigned to @liz, mitigation patch merged 2024-11-18, CVE crosswalk attached. No exploitable config drift found in that service.
ingrid (auditor): Perfect — for submission I need: 1) text export of RBAC PR + approver comments, 2) IdP policy screenshot + timestamped policy ID, 3) KMS log CSV slice, 4) vuln triage summary sentence, 5) emergency access runbook link. Can you bundle and mark which files are sensitive?
meera (sec-eng): Will prepare a zipped evidence bundle. Marking sensitive: KMS logs contain ARNs/ips — mark as restricted. We'll redact IPs in public copy and provide full copy via secure upload to your SFTP.
liz (devops): Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/emergency-kms-access (requires SSO). I will add a short note in the runbook about steps we use for this service.
jordan (oncall): FYI security-bot posted a recent alert about a KMS API anomaly on 2024-11-20 — false positive, attribution to canary test. posting snippet: security-bot: "KMS anomaly detected 11/20 03:12 UTC — triggered by canary-keytest from infra-canary. No followup required."
ingrid (auditor): Thanks — can you get the bundle to our secure intake by Mon 09:00 PST? that'll let us map controls to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9.2.2.
meera (sec-eng): Agree. I'll upload to the secure intake and ping here once done.
sam (infra): Starting export now. ETA ~45m.
liz (devops): I'll add the RBAC diff + MFA screenshot to the bundle.
meera (sec-eng): Uploaded to sftp://auditor-upload.redwood/5823456789-infer-routing-evidence (shared externally). Notes: bundle contains README.md with control mapping to SOC2 and ISO controls, and a redaction log.
ingrid (auditor): Received. Quick follow-up: can you confirm retention policy for KMS logs and where the golden copy is stored?
sam (infra): Golden copy: s3://redwood-audit/golden/kms/2024/ with 7-year retention (governed). Production export copy we sent is a timeboxed extract.
ingrid (auditor): All good. Thanks everyone. Closing this thread after we file the control map. :thumbsup:
meera (sec-eng): Thanks — will file the CC mapping doc to the compliance drive and link in ticket.
security-bot: Incident bot note: no incidents tied to this service in the last 90 days.
